name: How much does commercial building cleanup cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does commercial building cleanup cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of commercial building cleanup varies significantly based on the type and extent of damage, the size of the affected area, and the specific services required (e.g., water extraction, mold remediation, odor removal). A detailed assessment by professionals is necessary to provide an accurate estimate. Many cleanup services may be covered by commercial insurance policies.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary based on damage type, extent, and services needed; a professional assessment provides an estimate.
